paragraph: The Granville composite delivers a neutral primary verdict of 50/100, as an active breadth divergence caps the reading at 60 due to a declining equal-weight RSP/SPY ratio (-0.64%) during price advances. Beneath the surface, aggressive risk appetite in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +4.70%) and high-beta assets (SPHB/SPLV +3.74%) is undercut by economic weakness in transports (IYT/SPY -0.44%) and a lower defensive relative ratio (XLP/XLY -1.23%). Macro conditions offer a supportive counterweight, anchored by a calm VIX at 17.06 in steep contango, stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.69%, and falling 10-year real yields at 2.31%. However, back-loaded volatility skew (-7.9 points) signals that institutional traders are quietly hedging longer-dated tail risk rather than aggressively chasing broad market upside. Directionally, the session leans toward a narrow, tech-led upward drift, but broad-market rallies remain vulnerable to failure until equal-weight participation confirms the move.
